title: The Disciples Gather
summary: After journeying, preaching, and baptizing, the disciples gather in united prayer and fasting.

explicit_facts.text: The disciples journeyed, preached what they had heard and seen, and baptized in the name of Jesus.
The disciples gathered together in mighty prayer and fasting.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The disciples are shown gathered in prayer.
unspecified_visual_details: The gathering place, number of disciples, their clothing, and the time of day are not specified.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the preceding journey, preaching, or baptisms as part of this gathering moment.

title: Jesus Appears Among Them
summary: Jesus appears while the disciples pray and stands in their midst, asking what they want him to give them.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus showed himself to the disciples as they prayed to the Father in his name.
Jesus came and stood in their midst and asked what they wanted him to give them.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Jesus stands among the gathered disciples.
unspecified_visual_details: The disciples' precise arrangement and Jesus's clothing or physical features are not specified.

spoken_dialogue.text: What will ye that I shall give unto you?
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a particular manner of Jesus's appearance beyond his showing himself and standing among them.

title: The Disciples Ask About the Church's Name
summary: The disciples ask Jesus what name they should call the church, because people are disputing the matter.

explicit_facts.text: The disciples asked Jesus to tell them the name by which they should call the church.
There were disputations among the people concerning the church's name.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The disciples address Jesus in the gathering.
unspecified_visual_details: The disputing people are not stated to be present.

spoken_dialogue.text: Lord, we will that thou wouldst tell us the name whereby we shall call this church;
spoken_dialogue.speaker: the disciples of Jesus

prohibited_inventions: Do not show the disputing people as present or depict a dispute.

title: Called by Christ's Name
summary: Jesus questions why people murmur and dispute, then teaches that his name is to be taken upon them and that those who endure will be saved.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus asks why people murmur and dispute about this matter.
Jesus says the scriptures teach that they must take upon themselves the name of Christ.
Jesus teaches that whoever takes his name and endures to the end will be saved at the last day.

unspecified_visual_details: No scripture scroll or written text is specified.

spoken_dialogue.text: why is it that the people should murmur and dispute because of this thing?
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

spoken_dialogue.text: ye must take upon you the name of Christ, which is my name?
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

spoken_dialogue.text: the same shall be saved at the last day.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict salvation or the last day as a visible event.

title: The Church Called in His Name
summary: Jesus instructs them to do things and call upon the Father in his name, and explains that a church called in his name is his church if built upon his gospel.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus says they should do things and call upon the Father in his name, and call the church in his name.
Jesus teaches that a church called in his name is his church if built upon his gospel.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Jesus addresses the disciples as he teaches.
unspecified_visual_details: The church's name is not presented as a written inscription.

spoken_dialogue.text: therefore ye shall call the church in my name;
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

spoken_dialogue.text: but if it be called in my name then it is my church, if it so be that they are built upon my gospel.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Jesus uses the examples of Moses' name and a man's name as explanation, not as a narrated visual event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Moses or an unnamed man as physically present.

title: Built Upon the Gospel
summary: Jesus teaches those he addresses about the church being built upon his gospel, contrasts it with works of men or the devil, and tells them to remember his words.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus says those he addresses are built upon his gospel and should call the things they do in his name.
Jesus says the Father will hear a call made for the church in his name.
Jesus says the Father will show forth his works in a church built upon his gospel.
Jesus warns that those whose works are not built upon his gospel have joy for a season, then are hewn down and cast into fire.
Jesus says their works follow them and tells those he addresses to remember what he has told them.

unspecified_visual_details: The listeners’ appearances and the physical setting are not described.

spoken_dialogue.text: if ye call upon the Father, for the church, if it be in my name the Father will hear you;
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

spoken_dialogue.text: And if it so be that the church is built upon my gospel then will the Father show forth his own works in it.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

spoken_dialogue.text: therefore remember the things that I have told you.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The hewing down and casting into fire are part of Jesus’s warning, not an event narrated as occurring here.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a church being destroyed, people being cast into fire, or the Father’s works as a visible event.
Do not add a specific setting, named listeners, or dialogue.

title: The Gospel Jesus Gives
summary: Jesus declares that he came to do his Father's will and describes being lifted upon the cross so he might draw all people to him for judgment according to their works.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus says he came into the world to do the will of his Father, who sent him.
Jesus says his Father sent him to be lifted upon the cross, to draw all people to him, and that people will stand before him to be judged by their works.
Jesus says he will draw all people to him to be judged according to their works.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Jesus teaches the disciples in their gathering.
unspecified_visual_details: The crucifixion, the judgment, and the people drawn to Jesus are described in the teaching, not shown as present events.

spoken_dialogue.text: I came into the world to do the will of my Father, because my Father sent me.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

spoken_dialogue.text: my Father sent me that I might be lifted up upon the cross;
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The cross and future judgment are spoken of as teachings, not present visual events.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the crucifixion or judgment as happening in this scene.

title: Enduring to the End
summary: Jesus teaches that those who repent, are baptized in his name, and endure to the end will be held guiltless. He warns of the consequence of not enduring and affirms that the words given to the children of men are fulfilled.

explicit_facts.text: Whoever repents and is baptized in Jesus's name shall be filled; those who endure to the end will be held guiltless before his Father when he judges the world.
Jesus describes one who does not endure to the end as hewn down and cast into fire, unable to return because of the Father's justice.
The word given to the children of men is fulfilled; its giver does not lie but fulfills all his words.

unspecified_visual_details: The location, audience, and Jesus's physical appearance are not described in these verses.

spoken_dialogue.text: and if he endureth to the end, behold, him will I hold guiltless before my Father at that day when I shall stand to judge the world.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

spoken_dialogue.text: And he that endureth not unto the end, the same is he that is also hewn down and cast into the fire,
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

spoken_dialogue.text: and he lieth not, but fulfilleth all his words.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Judgment and fire are teachings here, not events narrated as visibly occurring.
prohibited_inventions: Do not stage a baptism, judgment, or someone being cast into fire.
Do not depict the Father or invent a physical appearance for Jesus.
Do not invent audience members, surroundings, actions, or additional dialogue.

title: Come Unto Me
summary: Jesus teaches that no unclean thing can enter his kingdom and commands all the earth to repent, come to him, and be baptized in his name.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus says no unclean thing can enter his kingdom and describes those entering his rest as having washed their garments in his blood through faith, repentance, and faithfulness.
Jesus commands all the ends of the earth to repent, come to him, and be baptized in his name, to be sanctified by the Holy Ghost and stand spotless at the last day.

unspecified_visual_details: No garment washing, blood, baptism, Holy Ghost appearance, or last-day scene is depicted.

spoken_dialogue.text: Repent, all ye ends of the earth, and come unto me
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Washing garments in Christ's blood is figurative teaching, not a literal visible scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict blood, stained garments, or a visible form of the Holy Ghost.

title: Do the Works Jesus Did
summary: Jesus calls this his gospel, tells the disciples to do the works they have seen him do, and says they will be blessed and lifted up if they do these things.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus says this is his gospel and that the disciples know what to do in his church.
Jesus says the disciples are to do the works they have seen him do.
Jesus says they are blessed if they do these things and will be lifted up at the last day.

unspecified_visual_details: The works previously seen and the last day are not depicted.

spoken_dialogue.text: for the works which ye have seen me do that shall ye also do;
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Being lifted up at the last day is teaching, not a present visual event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not add examples of Christ's works not identified in these verses.

title: Write What You Have Seen and Heard
summary: Jesus commands the disciples to write what they have seen and heard, except what is forbidden, and to write the works of this people.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus tells the disciples to write the things they have seen and heard, except those that are forbidden.
Jesus tells them to write the works of this people, as has been written of what has been.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Jesus gives the command to the disciples.
unspecified_visual_details: No writing materials or act of writing is specified.

spoken_dialogue.text: Write the things which ye have seen and heard,
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

prohibited_inventions: Do not show the disciples writing unless treated as an unspecified design choice.

title: Books and Judgment
summary: Jesus teaches that people will be judged from written books and tells the disciples they will be judges of this people, asking what manner of men they ought to be.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus says this people will be judged out of books written, and their works will be known through them.
Jesus says all things are written by the Father and the world will be judged from books to be written.
Jesus says the disciples will be judges of this people according to the just judgment he gives, and asks what manner of men they ought to be.

unspecified_visual_details: No books, judgment scene, or other people are specified as visibly present.

spoken_dialogue.text: Therefore, what manner of men ought ye to be?
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

spoken_dialogue.text: even as I am.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Judgment from books is teaching, not a scene of the judgment itself.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the Father, books, or people being judged as present.

title: Ask and Receive
summary: Jesus says he is going to the Father and promises that requests made to the Father in his name will be given; he teaches them to ask and knock.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus says he is going to the Father and that whatever they ask the Father in his name will be given.
Jesus teaches them to ask and receive, and to knock and have it opened.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Jesus continues speaking to the disciples.
unspecified_visual_details: No departure or door-opening is narrated in these verses.

spoken_dialogue.text: And now I go unto the Father.

title: Jesus's Joy in the Generation
summary: Jesus says his joy is full because of the disciples and the living generation, and that the Father and holy angels rejoice because none of them are lost.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus says his joy is full because of the disciples and this generation, and that the Father and all holy angels rejoice because of them.
Jesus clarifies that he means those now alive of this generation, and says none are lost and he has fulness of joy in them.

title: Sorrow for the Fourth Generation
summary: Jesus expresses sorrow for the fourth generation, saying they will be led captive and sell him for worldly goods, and that he will visit them by turning their works upon their own heads.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus says he sorrows for the fourth generation, who will be led captive by him as was the son of perdition.
Jesus says they will sell him for silver, gold, and corruptible or stolen goods, and that he will visit them by turning their works upon their own heads.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Jesus delivers this warning to the disciples.
unspecified_visual_details: The future fourth generation and the son of perdition are not described as present.

title: The Strait Gate
summary: After Jesus ends these sayings, he tells his disciples to enter through the strait gate, contrasting the narrow way to life with the broad way to death until night comes.

explicit_facts.text: When Jesus had ended these sayings, he told his disciples to enter at the strait gate.
Jesus contrasts the narrow way leading to life with the broad way leading to death, and says night comes when no man can work.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Jesus concludes his sayings while addressing the disciples.
unspecified_visual_details: No literal gate, roads, travelers, or nightfall are narrated as visible events.
